notes.title: We have released the Chinese version of Re;quartz Raid!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663834/f19eb28ad072c78e01f8e7fab19250d9bcc9726d.png
We have released the Chinese version of Re;quartz Raid!
Please enjoy!

~Notice~
We are very sorry, but due to circumstances with the company we had
commissioned to produce the English version, production has been
cancelled. We sincerely apologize to those who were looking forward to
it.
The Chinese version is only available for Windows.
